notes: All controls use births to US residents except the occurrence and foreign-resident controls.
Table 32 uses reporting flags and combines C/P as stated on guide page 69. The spina bifida control excludes Virginia through its reporting flag.
PDF page 156 is Table 32, although the contents list gives page 155. Suppressed cells and rounded rates are not used as exact controls.
